name: Tortoise Shell
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 6

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M/DF

Range touch

Target living creature touched

Duration 10 min./level

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

You touch a creature and they grow a large tortoise-like shell on their backs. The shell grants an enhancement bonus to their natural armor equal to 1/2 your caster level. A creature with no natural armor is treated to have a natural armor of +0 for this purpose. The tortoise shell slows the target’s movement as if they were wearing heavy armor. However, this only impacts their speed, it does not impose a spell failure chance or armor check penalty. This affects the creature even if they would be immune to the slowing of armor, like dwarves.
